questions.question: How many loans are 90 days in arrears?
questions.answer: There are 35 loans that are 90 days in arrears [T1].
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS arrears_90_count
FROM mart_credit.loan
WHERE status = 'ARREARS_90'

questions.question: How many home loans are there?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS home_loan_count
FROM mart_credit.loan
WHERE product = 'Home Loan'

questions.question: What is the average interest rate of term loans, rounded to 2 decimals?
questions.answer: The average interest rate of term loans, rounded to 2 decimals, is 5.40 [T1].

  ROUND(AVG(interest_rate), 2) AS avg_interest_rate
FROM 
  mart_credit.loan

questions.question: What is the average loan-to-value of collateral, rounded to 2 decimals?
questions.answer: The average loan-to-value of collateral is 58.66 [T1].
sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(loan.ltv_pct), 2) AS avg_ltv_pct
FROM 
  mart_credit.loan loan
JOIN 
  mart_credit.collateral collateral 
  ON loan.loan_id = collateral.loan_id
WHERE 
  collateral.collateral_type IN ('Residential property', 'Commercial property', 'Fixed charge', 'Receivables', 'Inventory', 'Vehicle')

SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(c.ltv_pct), 2) AS avg_ltv_pct
FROM 
  mart_credit.collateral c
JOIN 
  mart_credit.loan l ON c.loan_id = l.loan_id

questions.question: Under the home loan policy, what is the maximum first-facility LTV for investment residential property, and how many collateral records have an LTV above 70%?
questions.answer: The maximum first-facility LTV for investment residential property is 70% [1]. There are 99 collateral records with an LTV above 70% [T1].
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_ltv_collateral_count
FROM mart_credit.collateral
WHERE ltv_pct > 70
